problem_statement: SIH-26054: AI/ML Powered Digital Twin of UAV Propulsion System

tasks.title: Fix ReplayEngine Telemetry CSV File Path Lookup
tasks.current_state: backend/telemetry/replay_engine.py looks for report_dump/<mission_id>/readings/telemetry_log.csv. Sorties are actually saved in data/telemetry/live_sorties/<mission_id>.csv. Every call to /api/replay/{id}/frame returns HTTP 404.
tasks.target_state: ReplayEngine checks both data/telemetry/live_sorties/ and report_dump/ with fallback discovery. /api/replay/{id}/frame streams frames accurately to frontend ReplayScrubber component.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to Mission Replay tab and selecting any live sortie loads the full frame count without 404.
Scrubbing slider smoothly interpolates telemetry readings in GCS gauges.

tasks.title: Fix Hardcoded Drive Path in test_camera_transitions.py
tasks.current_state: tests/test_camera_transitions.py line 53 hardcodes 'e:\backup-llm\backup-no-llm\3d_engine', causing pytest test collection to fail unless explicitly ignored.
tasks.target_state: Path is resolved relative to Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / '3d_engine', with graceful skip if asset folder is absent in CI.
acceptance_criteria: Running `pytest tests/` passes cleanly without requiring `--ignore=tests/test_camera_transitions.py`.

tasks.title: Unify Split App.tsx Architecture into Single Multi-View Navigation
tasks.current_state: frontend/src/App.tsx uses useState<'runtime' | 'legacy'>('runtime'). It defaults to EngineRuntimeConsole, completely hiding the 6-tab GCS (Flight Deck, Propulsion, Maintenance, AI Diagnostics, Voice, Replay) and the 3D twin behind a toggle button.
tasks.target_state: Header features a global Engine Selection dropdown (Rotax 912 iS, 914, 915 iS, Austro AE300, VRDE Jayem). Top-level tab navigation offers: 1. Mission Control (Flight Deck), 2. Propulsion Engineering (Telemetry/Residuals), 3. 3D Digital Twin, 4. Fleet & Multi-Engine Runtime, 5. Maintenance & CBM, 6. AI Copilot & Voice, 7. Mission Replay.
acceptance_criteria: User can access 3D Twin, Engine Runtime Console, and all 6 GCS views from top navigation without toggling legacy mode.
Active engine switch updates telemetry header across all views.
tasks.verification_method: npm run build succeeds; browser subagent verifies tab navigation renders all views without console errors.

tasks.title: Deep Embed Three.js 3D Digital Twin into Dedicated View with Bi-Directional Event Sync
tasks.current_state: The rich Three.js twin exists in apps/threejs_twin/ served at /apps/threejs_twin/ with Draco-compressed UAV and engine GLB models, heatmap shaders, and X-ray cuts, but is only linked via target='_blank' in Header.tsx.
tasks.target_state: 3D Twin is embedded in an active tab via TwinIframeView with postMessage bridge transmitting live RPM, temperatures, and active injected faults to drive Three.js thermal mesh coloring and camera focus.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking '3D Digital Twin' renders the interactive Three.js viewport directly inside the main UI frame.
Injecting an EGT or CHT fault in the control panel highlights the corresponding cylinder head in red within the 3D twin.
tasks.verification_method: Inspect iframe DOM, verify postMessage listener receives state updates.

tasks.title: Synchronize EngineRuntimeHub Multi-Engine State with Telemetry Services
tasks.current_state: Switching active engine in /api/engines/{id}/activate changes RuntimeHub active engine, but EngineStateService continues running Rotax 912 iS physics independently.
tasks.target_state: Selecting an engine in Header updates EngineStateService model parameters (displacement, max RPM, turbocharger presence, thermal baselines) matching the selected engine specification.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting Austro AE300 updates telemetry baselines to diesel turbo parameters (Common rail pressure, Jet A-1 fuel flow).
Telemetry gauge labels and operating limits adjust dynamically.
tasks.verification_method: Call POST /api/engines/austro_ae300/activate; verify GET /api/state reflects AE300 specifications.

tasks.title: Expose MissionReliabilityEngine and PrescriptiveAdvisor in Frontend
tasks.current_state: backend/mission/reliability.py and backend/mission/prescriptive.py calculate Monte Carlo mission reliability probability and power derating actions, but lack API endpoints and are omitted from FlightDeck.
tasks.target_state: Expose GET /api/mission/reliability and GET /api/mission/prescriptive. Visualize mission completion probability R(t), failure risks, and recommended RPM derate ladder in MissionReadinessCard.
acceptance_criteria: Flight Deck shows live Mission Reliability score (e.g. 98.4%) calculated by Monte Carlo simulation.
When an injector clog is injected, PrescriptiveAdvisor suggests derating RPM with recommended throttle cap.
tasks.verification_method: Run curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/mission/reliability; verify valid JSON response and rendering on FlightDeck.

tasks.title: Implement Browser Web Speech Fallback for Voice Copilot
tasks.current_state: backend/voice/ routes require whisper ggml-tiny.en.bin and Kokoro TTS models which are absent from git repository, causing /api/voice/converse to fail with 500 error when invoked.
tasks.target_state: VoiceCopilot detects if backend voice synthesis is unavailable and seamlessly falls back to window.webkitSpeechRecognition / SpeechRecognition and window.speechSynthesis, while routing queries to /api/ai/ask.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking microphone button records speech in modern browsers even if backend whisper binary is missing.
AI response is vocalized using local speech synthesis and cited against OEM manuals.
tasks.verification_method: Test VoiceCopilot UI in browser with audio input, verifying immediate speech response.

tasks.title: Expose Diagnostic Bayesian Network and DualPath RUL in CBM Views
tasks.current_state: DiagnosticBayesianNetwork and DualPathRULEstimator exist as unit-tested offline modules but are not wired into FastAPI /api/cbm or /api/diagnostics routes.
tasks.target_state: Expose GET /api/diagnostics/bayesian and GET /api/prognostics/dual-path-rul endpoints. Display posterior probability distribution and physics-ML blended RUL confidence bounds in MaintenanceCBM.
acceptance_criteria: Maintenance & CBM tab displays dual-path RUL with clear physics vs ML breakdown.
Diagnostic view shows Bayesian network node belief probabilities.
tasks.verification_method: pytest tests/test_diagnostics_bn.py and pytest tests/test_rul_dual_path.py pass; GET returns valid payload.

tasks.title: Add Physics vs ML Residual Tracking and Drift Visualizer
tasks.current_state: Backend computes 14 residuals (EGT, CHT, MAP, Fuel Flow, Oil Pressure, etc.) and split-conformal p-values, but frontend only shows a subset of raw residuals without threshold bands.
tasks.target_state: Propulsion Engineer tab includes dedicated ResidualDriftChart showing raw vs modeled values, dynamic 3-sigma error bounds, and conformal calibration status.

data_schema.residuals: Record<string, {actual: number, modeled: number, delta: number, sigma: number}>

acceptance_criteria: Engineers can inspect real-time residual drift curves with alert thresholds for all 14 monitored parameters.
tasks.verification_method: Inject sensor bias fault and verify residual curve crosses threshold with visual alert.

tasks.title: Integrate Automatic Sortie Debrief Generation and PDF/Markdown Download
tasks.current_state: backend/debrief/post_flight.py provides comprehensive post-flight debriefing with JSON/Markdown export, but the UI has no button to trigger generation or download the report.
tasks.target_state: Add 'Generate Mission Debrief' button in Flight Deck / Maintenance views opening DebriefModal with live markdown preview and one-click download.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Generate Debrief' calls backend debrief engine, presents formatted sortie summary, and allows export.
tasks.verification_method: Trigger debrief generation via UI; verify exported markdown matches backend output.
